setting.note: A young provincial arrives in Paris in 1840 and spends the next decade drifting through its boulevards, salons and studios in love with a married woman, while the 1848 revolution rises and dies around him.

rights.originalWork: Public domain. Gustave Flaubert, first published 1869; the author died in 1880. Mapped here as a cited work: we store none of its text and reproduce no passages. The places are facts and the notes are our own.

palette.note: The tarnished gold of lost illusions, a hero's youth spent and nothing quite achieved. A worn brass tone that clears WCAG AA on paper.
